svg.title: 1. Checkout: one store per service
svg.text: Checkout architecture: each service owns its data, and events leave through an outbox
Sync calls carry a deadline and an idempotency key. Nothing reads another service's database.
sync calls from the orchestrator (gRPC/HTTP, 2 s deadline, retried with the same key)
Event broker (Kafka, Pub/Sub, Service Bus, EventBridge)
Consumers dedupe on event id: the broker delivers at least once.
